name: StorePlus Manual QR Gateway with PromptPay for WooCommerce
author: wpstoreplus

sections.description:
StorePlus Manual QR Gateway with PromptPay for WooCommerce helps Thai WooCommerce store owners accept manual PromptPay QR payments.

The plugin generates a PromptPay QR code based on the WooCommerce order amount and displays the QR code, payment amount, recipient name, order number, and payment instructions on the order received page.

This plugin is designed for manual payment verification. It does not connect to a bank API, does not automatically confirm payments, and does not process card payments.

Features

  • Add PromptPay QR as a WooCommerce payment method.
  • Generate PromptPay QR codes based on WooCommerce order totals.
  • Support registered mobile number, National ID / Tax ID, and E-Wallet PromptPay receiver IDs.
  • Display recipient name, amount, order number, and payment instructions.
  • Let store owners choose On hold or Pending payment while waiting for manual verification.
  • Let customers upload JPG, PNG, or WebP payment slips after checkout and from My Account orders.
  • Preview the selected slip image before upload and allow customers to replace a submitted slip.
  • Display the payment slip inside the WooCommerce order screen for administrators.
  • Confirm a manually verified payment from the order screen and choose the resulting order status.
  • Download the generated PromptPay QR code from the order payment page.
  • Generate a test PromptPay QR from the admin diagnostics page before accepting real orders.
  • Show customer payment instructions in WooCommerce emails.
  • Include a WooCommerce admin status page for configuration checks.
  • Generate QR codes locally without using an external QR image service.

Important Notes

This plugin is designed for WooCommerce stores in Thailand that accept manual PromptPay QR payments in Thai Baht (THB).

A normal bank account number is not a PromptPay ID. Store owners must enter a PromptPay receiver ID that is registered with their bank.

International QR payments may work only with participating cross-border QR payment applications. Availability depends on the customer’s bank, country, and payment provider.

Privacy

This plugin generates PromptPay QR codes locally on the WordPress site. When payment slip upload is enabled, customer slip images are stored in the site’s WordPress Media Library and referenced from the WooCommerce order. The plugin does not send order data, customer data, PromptPay settings, or slip images to StorePlus, a bank API, or an external QR service.

Store owners are responsible for protecting uploaded payment slips according to their privacy policy and for manually verifying payments in their banking app or bank account before processing orders.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Enable PromptPay QR Payment.
  5. Enter your PromptPay ID type, PromptPay ID, and recipient name.
  6. Save changes and test checkout with Thai Baht (THB) as the store currency.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically verify payments?

No. This plugin is designed for manual PromptPay QR payments. Store owners must verify payments manually before processing orders.

Does this plugin connect to a bank API?

No. The plugin does not connect to a bank API and does not send payment data to any external service.

Does this plugin support slip upload?

Yes. Version 1.1.0 allows customers to upload JPG, PNG, or WebP payment slip images after checkout and from their order page. Store administrators must still verify the payment manually.

Does this plugin support currencies other than Thai Baht?

This free version is designed for Thai Baht (THB) stores only.

Can I enter a bank account number as the PromptPay ID?

No. A bank account number is not a PromptPay ID. Enter a registered PromptPay receiver ID, such as a registered Thai mobile number, National ID / Tax ID, or E-Wallet ID.

Why does my banking app say the receiver account is invalid?

This usually means the configured ID is not registered as a PromptPay receiver for the selected type, a bank account number was entered instead of a PromptPay ID, or the same bank account is being used to scan and pay itself.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is required.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Updated WordPress compatibility metadata for WordPress 7.1.
  • No functional changes.

1.1.1

  • Fixed missing frontend JavaScript file in the release package.
  • Fixed missing payment proof handler file in the release package.
  • Improved release packaging reliability.

1.1.0

  • Added customer payment slip uploads for JPG, PNG, and WebP images.
  • Added payment slip preview before upload and replacement of previously submitted slips.
  • Added payment slip details to the WooCommerce order admin screen.
  • Added a nonce-protected administrator action to manually confirm payments.
  • Added configurable order status after checkout and after payment verification.
  • Added QR code download button and clearer step-by-step payment instructions.
  • Added payment box and slip upload support on My Account > View order.
  • Expanded diagnostics with WordPress, WooCommerce, PHP, HPOS, uploads directory, and slip upload checks.
  • Added a local test QR generator to the diagnostics page.
  • Preserved the existing StorePlus gateway ID and settings compatibility.

1.0.14

  • Renamed the plugin for WordPress.org trademark and naming review.
  • Updated the plugin slug and text domain to storeplus-manual-qr-gateway.
  • Kept the tested WooCommerce checkout behavior unchanged.

1.0.12

  • WordPress.org cleanup build.
  • Improved readme documentation, privacy wording, and Thailand/THB support notes.
  • Improved admin status output escaping and settings value sanitization.
  • Kept the tested WooCommerce checkout behavior unchanged.

1.0.0

  • Initial free release.
  • Added manual PromptPay QR payment gateway for WooCommerce.
  • Added PromptPay ID type and receiver settings.
  • Added QR code display on the order received page.
  • Added customer payment instructions.
  • Added On hold order workflow for manual verification.
